description: This file defines the BasketViewModelService class, a service responsible for managing shopping basket view models, retrieving or creating baskets, and mapping basket data to view models within an e-commerce web application.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that provides operations for retrieving, creating, and mapping basket view models in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves an existing basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket for a specified user.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Converts a collection of BasketItem entities into a list of BasketItemViewModels, including fetching related catalog item details.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to its corresponding BasketViewModel, including basket items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in a user's basket.
